name: multishot-story
description: Мультфильм или фильм из многокадровых роликов LTX-2.5: в каждом ролике 2–3 плана со склейками внутри («Shot 1 … Cut to shot 2 …») — герои держатся внутри ролика, а склеек между роликами меньше. LLM пишет подробный план (сюжет, планы и движение камеры, свет, звуки, реплики) → опорный кадр с героями → ролики цепочкой по хвосту → склейка. Длина ≈ clips × clip секунд (по умолчанию 8 × 15 = 2 минуты)

characters.description: герои и их постоянная внешность (одними и теми же словами в каждом плане)

nodes.prompt: You are a screenwriter and storyboard artist for an original animated film. Story: «{{story}}». Characters (describe them with exactly these words every time they appear): {{characters}}. Write exactly {{clips}} consecutive clips that tell the whole story with a clear setup, twists and an ending. Each clip is ONE line in English made of {{shots}} shots: "Shot 1: … Cut to shot 2: … Cut to shot 3: …". In every shot give: the shot size and camera (wide / medium / close-up, push-in, pan, tracking, low or high angle), where it happens, what the characters do (with their fixed descriptions), light and mood, and sounds (noises, music) described as sounds. Add short spoken lines: at most one or two per clip, each 3–8 words, in {{lang}} inside «» quotes, marking who speaks, e.g. the duck says in {{lang}}: «…»; all speech of a clip must fit {{clip}} seconds at about 2.5 syllables per second; after the last line describe a silent action. Output only the {{clips}} lines, one clip per line — no preamble, no numbering, no comments.
{{characters}} together at the start of the story: {{story}}. {{style}}, film still, all characters fully visible
